attributes.name: Accursed Priest
attributes.powers:
The Accursed Priest is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

The difficulty of the check to defeat is increased by the scenario's adventure deck number. Blessings add 1d4 instead of the normal die on your checks to defeat the Accursed Priest.

If defeated, recharge a random blessing from your discard pile.

If undefeated, bury the bottom card of your deck.

changes.explanation: No problem. If you'd like an easier run, make these optional changes.

fragments.expected: If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.

changes.instruction:
Make one or both of these changes only if you're looking for an easier time with Wrath B scenarios.
On the B and C henchman Tangle Trap, add the line "If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from."
Move some or all of the following cards from Set B and/or C to Set 1, and change their set indicators to 1: the barrier Arboreal Blight (B & C), the monster Carrion Golem (B & C), and 1 of the Demonic Horde barriers in B and/or the Demonic Horde barrier currently in C.  Then move some or all of the following cards from Set 1 to Set B, and change their set indicators to B: the monster Accursed Priest and the barrier Poisoned Spiked Pit Trap.
changes.question: The B scenarios in Wrath are really hard! What if I don't want them to be so hard?
changes.review_note: Paizo explicitly offers this as an optional change. Retain the original wording and the option separately; absence is not a missing mandatory erratum.
